narrationTexts: Let me run the build to confirm the failure before fixing anything.

Confirmed — the real failure is buried under the deprecation noise: a `TypeError` in the link stage from `options.retries` being undefined. Both bugs stem from the bundler bump changing option shapes. Fixing both call sites.
finalText:
Build now exits clean (0 errors). Two real bugs were hiding under the deprecation-warning noise, both from the bundler bump changing option shapes:

- `src/core/options.js`: `resolveRetries` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `{ retryCount }` — threw `TypeError` on `undefined.toFixed()`. Fixed to read `options.retryCount`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js`: `isBackoffEnabled` only accepted literal `true`/`false` and threw on anything else, but the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`. Fixed to treat `undefined` as disabled.

The remaining 8 warnings are just the deprecation/lint noise (`DEP0142`, `DEP0198`, etc.) baked into the build log — not errors, and unrelated to the crash.
